text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Alert A-22123 — auth-proxy unusual egress/auth traffic spike detected. metric: auth-proxy.requests_by_ip (10x baseline). sample IPs: 45.33.12.7, 103.21.55.9. first seen 2026-04-01 10:12 UTC.

sre_oncall: ack — I'm oncall, investigating. checking proxy pods and metrics.

eng_prod: looking at recent proxy logs — pattern: repeated 401s followed by occasional 200s, user-agents show 'python-requests/2.31' and 'curl/7.86'. some requests include Authorization headers but masked in logs (e.g. "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx..xxx").

sec_lead: any signs logs were forwarded off-cluster? if so treat as potential exposure.

obs_bot: log-forwarder: successful deliveries to s3://debug-uploads/redwood/prod/2026-04-01/ for time window 10:05-10:15 UTC. forwarding rule: debug-forwarder-ephemeral. (automated note)

eng_infra: paused forwarder config "debug-forwarder-ephemeral" (rolled to disabled). stopping any new deliveries.

eng_prod: confirmed no new objects since pause. I'll scan the uploaded objects for token-like patterns.

support_eng: any customer impact observed? are customers seeing auth failures?

sre_oncall: no service-wide degradation. a few customers had brief 401 spikes in their dashboards but total success rate unchanged.

sec_lead: assume exposure vector until proven otherwise. Triage plan: 1) block/stop forwarder (done). 2) rotate service account keys used by proxy. 3) revoke affected sessions/tokens. 4) preserve artifacts for forensics. assign eng_infra + eng_prod + legal.

eng_infra: starting key rotation for proxy service account. creating new keys, will update k8s secrets and Vault. ETA ~12m.

eng_prod: quick grep on forwarded objects found ~14 lines with partial bearer headers (masked fragments). redaction present but we treat as compromise.

legal: please snapshot the S3 objects and preserve ACLs. I'll open a legal hold and notify trust team.

eng_infra: rotated keys and updated secret in Vault. deploying proxy rollout (canary 10% -> full). will invalidate old keys after rollout.

sre_oncall: after rotation and rollout, suspicious traffic rate dropped back to baseline. continuing to monitor dashboards and WAF logs.

obs_bot: forensics archive created at s3://internal-archive/forensics/A-22123/ — access limited to infra/sec/legal. (automated note)

support_eng: drafting customer-facing template for trust communications; will wait for legal signoff.

sec_lead: follow-ups: - create INFSEC ticket INFSEC-22123 for full postmortem and timeline; - hard block: prevent log-forwarder from including Authorization headers; - add scrubbing middleware in proxy to zero Authorization before logs.

eng_prod: I can ship a small scrubber patch to proxy this afternoon — will add to next deploy.

legal: will assess notification requirements depending on artifacts found in archive. preserve chain of custody.

pagerbot: Incident A-22123 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Recommended: keep thread open until stable for 2 hours, then close and move to postmortem.

sre_oncall: will stay on watch for 2 hours and then escalate if anything recurs. posting final notes to INFSEC-22123 when done.

sec_lead: thanks all. summary and action items to go into postmortem: forwarder filters, masking guarantees, keys lifecycle, scrubber, and customer comms playbook.
